motive_lines: POWER, energy, the future, and access to the unknown, not commodity pricing.
Qiao: "It's not worth anything." / "That's the point." — you cannot price a thing that decides who gets to aim the future.
Ren's sabotage is not about saving a rock. It is about denying EVERYONE a planet-scale directed-energy source.
Voss's cover (helium-3 mining) was always the small, believable lie told about a thing too big to name.
as_device.rule: MOTIVE/NARRATIVE LEVEL ONLY: sims keep nuclear events as abstract impulse levers — no weapon-design mechanics, no yields. The story is about who holds the aim, not how the device is built.
as_device.summary: POWER, not price: everything in the core is RICH — high-grade nuclear feedstock automatically, because it is a core: differentiated, concentrated, refined by a planet instead of a lab. The inventory: californium, plutonium and beyond, superheavies past 118, pressure exotics. The kicker: the HYDROGEN is right there — the ice the crew has been burning is water; water is hydrogen; hydrogen is fusion fuel. The energy can be TARGETED — released in certain ways, directed, aimed. Not a pile of fuel: a directable, scalable nuclear source — massive energy you can aim.

cascade.algorithms: OPEN / FREE: the cascade math in the sim is open, public, in the repo — seeded, deterministic, inspectable. Rates and cross-sections fictional, labeled.
cascade.exhibit: CASCADE VIEW (Core screens C-1/C-2): live flow diagram — exotic feedstock nodes, animated neutron-hop streams (Pressure One), branching decay paths (Pressure Two), feedback loop visibly closing; counters FUEL BRED vs FUEL BURNED, multiplication factor k (fictional); pressure-mix slider re-tunes the cascade. Labels: SCHEMATIC — NOT TO SCALE.
cascade.heist_math: this is why the heist math never added up for a mining operation (motive-flip beat II): the "cargo" was multiplying — they were hauling a breeder, not cargo
cascade.mechanism: the core breeds fuel as it works: neutron capture cascades (Pressure One) build heavier nuclei — including new fissionables; decay chains (Pressure Two) throw off particles that feed further captures; the loop closes: the core makes MORE fuel than the story spends

axis_1.name: THE CHOICE
axis_1.question: did they pick Mimas because it was SMALL and EASY — the convenient moon — or because they already KNEW what the core held? Foreknowledge vs convenience. If they knew, the helium-3 cover was constructed from day one (Voss's job) and the "wrong in four ways" core was the target all along. Dotty never confirms.

axis_2.question: later, engineers and scientists argue: what was the core's parent planet — what TYPE, HOW OLD, what it CONTAINED, under what CONDITIONS that ancient world existed, and WHERE. Genuine unresolved disagreement, played as a transcript exhibit. Nobody wins.

millennium_questions.framing: the core's DATA poses questions the way the Millennium Prize poses math — open problems everyone, and every AI, is trying to answer

questions.question: "Liquid moving or whatever" — the core's interior dynamics pose an unsolved flow problem (Navier-Stokes flavor: how does matter move in there?)
"Map the transmutation network." Nobody has. The archive has partial decay/capture logs; Dotty marks the rest [UNOBSERVED].

"Was there life — or anything — that they destroyed?" — did Mimas, or the core's parent planet, hold life, or a record, or something irreplaceable that the stripping destroyed? UNANSWERED. The moral Millennium question — Ren's.

the_quote.line: We didn't crack a moon tonight. We cracked the century.

two_pressures.convergence: both regimes end the same way: they forge NEW STABLE exotic minerals with no Earth equivalent — exotic in, exotic out; stable forms of matter we have never seen
two_pressures.exhibit: TWO PRESSURES diagram (Core screens): same feedstock in, two pressure columns, two different element ladders, converging on new stable exotics

pressure_one.mechanism: neutron capture cascades hop mineral to mineral, building heavier and heavier nuclei — natural synthesis, live; this is where the superheavies past 118 get built and where the island-of-stability pockets get fed

pressure_two.mechanism: the same exotics behave differently — particles escape, protons get shoved out (proton emission), decay chains run down other paths; what Pressure One builds, Pressure Two can unbuild

two_pressures.summary: the core is not a dead rock with old elements — it is still COOKING; a planet-scale natural reactor with pressure-gated transmutation

world_watches.actor_response: the country (or whoever) that pulled it off has to answer the world while the evidence burns across the sky — Voss's cover story under maximum pressure
world_watches.arc: ~4–5 years; dramatic compression allowed where the story needs speed ("fast will be good")
world_watches.damage_question: OPEN — what does the debris do? A meteor uptick on Earth? satellite losses? Dotty marks casualty figures [DISPUTED]. See chain.json tail / TAIL FOOTPRINT sim.
world_watches.debate: nations watch, argue, grandstand — months of it: who authorized this? who owns a moon? was there life in what they stripped away? protests, summits, resolutions; the moon keeps coming
world_watches.tail: the voyage strips megatons of debris into a cometary tail trailing behind; as the moon travels inward the Sun warms the tail — volatiles sublimate, it brightens and spreads; a stolen moon with a glowing tail, visible in telescopes, then in the sky, for MONTHS — the world cannot look away

wrong_in_four_ways.name: CALIFORNIUM + TRANSURANICS
wrong_in_four_ways.note: fission material sitting there NATURALLY: californium plus the other transuranics — neptunium, plutonium, americium (the stuff in smoke detectors), curium, berkelium, einsteinium, fermium, on up. On Earth we have only ever made these in labs and reactors; here they are just sitting in the rock. Real-world anchor: californium-252 is synthetic — one of the most expensive substances ever made, a neutron source; native occurrence is the anomaly.

wrong_in_four_ways.name: PRESSURE EXOTICS
wrong_in_four_ways.note: minerals formed under BILLIONS OF YEARS of core pressure — high-pressure phases with no Earth equivalent

wrong_in_four_ways.name: SUPERHEAVIES PAST 118
wrong_in_four_ways.note: pieces of the periodic table WE HAVE NOT SYNTHESIZED — elements past 118. Some sit in the island of stability (stable); others are caught mid-decay, decaying 'to this and that' in active chains the archive is still logging. The archive's periodic-table exhibit has extra boxes. Some of them blink.
